decision_authority_map.supersession_authority: Decision succession lineage: evaluating Sequence N+1 with previous_decision_hash = Hash(Sequence N) deterministically transitions Sequence N to SUPERSEDED
decision_authority_map.sequence_authority: epoch-gov-002 monotonic integer sequence in GovernanceDecisionEngine and DECISION_SEQUENCE_EQUIVOCATION_AUDIT.json
decision_authority_map.predecessor_link_authority: previous_decision_hash embedded in canonical decision payload, verified against SHA-256 of predecessor snapshot

decision_status_model.current_definition: A decision snapshot with the highest sequence number in the active epoch, uninvalidated, binding the previous decision hash, and marked CURRENT in canonical baseline.
decision_status_model.superseded_definition: A valid decision snapshot whose decision_hash is bound as previous_decision_hash by a successor decision in the same epoch.
decision_status_model.stale_definition: A decision whose evaluation timestamp exceeds clock skew limits or whose underlying source/finding inputs have mutated without recomputation.
decision_status_model.invalidated_definition: A decision explicitly recorded in DECISION_INVALIDATION_REGISTRY.json with an invalidation authority, timestamp, and reason code, forbidding sequence reuse.
